Apple Unveils Foldable iPhone Duo and New iPhone 18 Series

Apple has launched its first foldable iPhone, named the iPhone Duo, alongside the new iPhone 18 series. The iPhone Duo is priced at approximately $1,999 (₹4.5 lakh) and is expected to be available in India in October. Key features of the foldable device include the absence of Face ID and a reportedly reduced crease. The company also announced new AirPods 5 with improved active noise cancellation and live translation capabilities. The launch event also featured Apple CEO John Ternus showcasing the new models.
